Multi-Unit for HOA Communities in San Francisco

Multi-Unit Roofing Project Completed with HOA in San Francisco

At ROOF EXPRESS, we recently completed a large-scale roofing project for a multi-apartment building in San Francisco, working closely with the Homeowners Association (HOA) to ensure a smooth and successful process from start to finish.

HOA projects require precision, communication, and compliance—and our team delivered on all fronts.

Seamless Coordination with HOA Management

Managing a roofing project for a multi-unit property involves more than just installation. It requires:

Coordinating with HOA board members

Following community guidelines and regulations

Maintaining clear communication with residents

Minimizing disruptions during construction

Our team worked hand-in-hand with the HOA to create a clear schedule, provide regular updates, and ensure every requirement was met.

Scope of the Multi-Apartment Roofing Project

This project included a full roofing system upgrade for a multi-unit residential building, including:

Complete tear-off and replacement of existing roofing materials

Installation of high-quality asphalt shingles

Upgraded waterproofing systems

Flashing replacement around penetrations and edges

Final inspection and quality assurance

Every detail was handled with care to ensure durability, weather resistance, and long-term performance.

Minimizing Disruption for Residents

We understand that working on occupied apartment buildings requires extra attention. Our crew ensured:

Clean and organized job sites daily

Safe working conditions for residents

Noise and disruption kept to a minimum

Fast, efficient project completion

Our goal was to deliver a high-quality roof while maintaining comfort for everyone living in the building.

Customer Satisfaction is Our Top Priority

The HOA and residents expressed high satisfaction with the final results. From communication to craftsmanship, our team made sure expectations were exceeded.

At ROOF EXPRESS, customer satisfaction is not just a goal—it’s the foundation of everything we do. We take pride in delivering results that build trust and long-term relationships.

Why HOAs Choose ROOF EXPRESS

Proven experience with multi-unit and HOA projects

Licensed, insured, and GAF Certified Installer

Clear communication and project transparency

High-quality materials and expert installation

Strong reputation across the San Francisco Bay Area

Serving San Francisco and the Entire Bay Area

If your HOA or property management company is planning a roofing project in San Francisco or nearby cities, ROOF EXPRESS is ready to help.

We specialize in large-scale residential and commercial roofing projects with a focus on quality, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

Get a Free HOA Roofing Consultation
